evals.prompt: 为 internal/backend/router/ 写一个 scoped AGENTS.md（压缩 pipe-index 格式）。要求：只写该 scope 相关的 Where-to-look/Conventions/Anti-patterns，不要复制全仓库目录结构。
evals.expected_output: 在 internal/backend/router/ 下生成完整 AGENTS.md，内容以 |IMPORTANT 开头，含 |Scope:internal/backend/router，并覆盖 router scope 的关键任务索引。
expectations: The output starts with a pipe-index AGENTS.md structure including a |IMPORTANT line.
The output contains scope-specific guidance for backend router work such as where-to-look, conventions, or anti-patterns.
The output does not dump a repo-wide top-level directory inventory unrelated to the router scope.

evals.prompt: 我最近在做 backend 的 api-v3 路由开发（新增 domain、加 handler、错误码、auth 中间件），请你先定位最合适的目录 scope，然后在那个目录下生成一份 scoped AGENTS.md（压缩格式）。如果有多个候选目录，先列出候选并让我选。
evals.expected_output: 先给出 2-6 个候选 scope root 目录并请求确认；确认后在 выбран scope 下生成 AGENTS.md，包含 scope 相关的 where-to-look（api-v3.go、domain load、options.Capability、pkg/rest/errf 等）。
expectations: The run records at least one candidate scope resolution step before the final output.
The final chosen scope is justified and documented when the eval proceeds without an actual user reply.
The final AGENTS.md is in compressed pipe-index format.
The final AGENTS.md includes router/api-v3 related guidance rather than generic repository guidance.

evals.prompt: 把 internal/backend/router/AGENTS.md 的内容改写为 pipe-index 压缩格式（保留信息，不要丢掉 handler 签名、error handling、type flow、anti-patterns 这些要点），输出仍然写回 internal/backend/router/AGENTS.md。
evals.expected_output: internal/backend/router/AGENTS.md 被改写为以 | 开头的压缩格式，保留原文关键信息点且更易扫描。
expectations: The rewritten output is primarily pipe-index style instead of traditional markdown sections.
The rewritten output preserves the handler signature guidance from the source AGENTS.md.
The rewritten output preserves error handling, type flow, and anti-pattern guidance from the source AGENTS.md.
The rewritten output is more compact than the source while retaining the requested facts.
